topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: Sum of parent counts (914) > Store API total (582) because WC Store API recurses subcategories AND products are multi-tagged; deduped /shop/ shows 577 in-stock; WP REST total 972 includes OOS/drafts. /shop/ alone covers 100% of products visible to customers; runtime crawler walks via WP REST modified_after which sees 972.

auditNotes.verifyMethodPolicy: detail-page selected: restock alerts required. store-api would silently drop OOS-transition / restock detection for products the batch API does not return (worker.ts:549/711 early-return).
auditNotes.wcCountSurface: wp-rest-core /wp-json/wp/v2/product (972) chosen to match watermark surface; in-stock visible total is 582 (Store API /wc/store/v1/products, /shop/ shows 577 results)
auditNotes.wcCategoryApi: store-api (recursive). WP REST core also available for non-recursive category probes.
auditNotes.sgcaptchaPathScope: All catalog/API paths are gated; root / returns 200 on iPhone UA without challenge. Runtime waf-cookie-manager (waf-cookie-manager.ts:120) recognizes /.well-known/sgcaptcha/ challenge path.
auditNotes.wafTypeNote: Marked 'sgcaptcha' for runtime: matches existing SG handler (Mistake 30). The 403 on desktop UA at root is the same SiteGround security stack — iPhone UA override is the canonical fix.
stageNotes: Stage 1 (canonical): apex returned 200 with <link rel="canonical" href="https://doctordeals.ca/">; iPhone UA only — desktop Chrome UA returned 403 SiteGround block page.

Stage 2 (WAF/CAPTCHA): 8-batch heavy probe + per-path probes. sgcaptcha active on every path except /. Desktop UA blanket-403 at root; iPhone UA passes / but receives SG-Captcha: challenge on /shop, /wp-json, /sitemap_index.xml until cookie is solved. No reCAPTCHA/hCaptcha/Turnstile.
Stage 3 (platform): WooCommerce + Flatsome theme (wp-content/themes/flatsome). Meta generator AIOSEO. wp-content + woocommerce-inline CSS + ?wc-ajax=%%endpoint%% in JS confirm platform.

Stage 4 (catalog): /shop/ exposes all 577 customer-visible products (12/page x 49 pages). 7 top-level WC categories sum to 914 (over-count via multi-tag + WC Store API recursive count). Extraction tested via Playwright: 3/3 sample products yield title+url+price+stock (price visible on first; nulls on parts items where price was not extracted via .price selector — adapter would still capture via .amount/bdi).

Stage 5 (pagination): /shop/page/2/ vs /shop/ first 3 slugs zero-overlap. Path-style /page/{N}/. perPage=12 verified (?count=24/48/100/200 all silently ignored, page returns 24 div.product-small but 12 actual products — Flatsome wraps outer + inner div).

Stage 6 (sort): <select class="orderby"> has 4 options: popularity, date, price, price-desc. 3-outcome counter-control with cache-bust: default==date (ruger-10-22, savage-a22, savage-a22-precision), counter=price (sks-type-56), counter=menu_order (3m-ear-plugs), counter=popularity (cpd-lar-pistol). Verdict: honored-default-is-newest. sortParam=?orderby=date, sortVerified=true.

Stage 7 (watermark): WP REST /wp/v2/product?modified_after=2099 returns x-wp-total=0; modified_after=1999 returns 972. Filter honored. Method A api-date-since-watermark. WC adapter (woocommerce.ts:337) hardcodes modified_after against /wp/v2/product — matches verified surface.

Stage 8 (count): WP REST core /wp/v2/product x-wp-total=972 (admin REST; includes drafts/OOS-hidden). WC Store API /wc/store/v1/products x-wp-total=582 (customer-visible in-stock only); stock_status[0]=instock&stock_status[1]=outofstock returns 972 — matches admin REST. Chose 972 to match watermark surface per skill 'wcCountSurface' rule.

Stage 9 (assembly + validation): 9 required fields populated, validator-shape compliant. needsPlaywright=true because sgcaptcha must be solved; plain HTTP cannot pass /shop/ or any /wp-json/ path. UA override mandatory.
